description: Set the link options of linked items and linked stories, or the document defaults: update when saving, warn before overwriting local edits, which local edits to preserve, removing forced line breaks and applying style mappings (Links panel > Link Options). Pass no options to read them.

documentDefaults.description: Set the document's default link options instead of (or as well as) items'

mapStyles.description: Apply the custom style mappings to linked stories (Define Custom Style Mapping; see manage_style_mappings) (stories)

preserveAppearance.description: Preserve Local Edits: Appearance (fill, stroke, effects) (page items)

preserveFrameContent.description: Preserve Local Edits: Frame Content (page items)

preserveSizeAndShape.description: Preserve Local Edits: Size and Shape (page items)

removeForcedLineBreaks.description: Remove Forced Line Breaks from Story (linked stories) (stories)

target.description: The linked items; text frames set their story's options

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

updateWhileSaving.description: Update Link When Saving Document (items and stories)

warnOnUpdate.description: Warn if Link Update Will Overwrite Local Edits (items and stories)

name: set_link_options
title: Set Link Options
